newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SOCCER-AIK STOCKHOLM V BARCELONA TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AIK STOCKHOLM V BARCELONA TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Thursday's European Cup Winners' Cup quarter-final second leg between AIK Stockholm of Sweden and Barcelona of Spain:

AIK - 1-Magnus Hedman, 3-Per Millqvist, 4-Ola Andersson, 5-Mikael Brundin, 9-Pascal Simpson, 10-Johan Mjallby, 26-Gary Sundgren, 27-Nebojsa Novakovic, 14-Thomas Lagerlof, 17-Pierre Gallo, 15-Cesar Pacha 15.

Barcelona - 1-Vitor Baia, 27-Fernando Couto, 20-Miguel Angel Nadal, 2-Albert Ferrer, 12-Sergi Barjuan, 4-Josep Guardiola, 5-Gheorghe Popescu, 23-Ivan de la Pena, 7-Luis Figo, 9-Ronaldo, 8-Hristo Stoitchkov.
